customer_id.meaning: primary id of the member record (content hash)

member_number.format: M- followed by five digits, e.g. M-04821
member_number.meaning: the cooperative membership number printed on every statement and settlement sheet

name.meaning: legal name of the member or of the member entity's authorised signer, as it appears on the membership application

farm_name.meaning: the farm or farming entity name the member trades under; blank for individual members who trade under their own name

phone_number.meaning: the mobile number on file for delivery and settlement notifications

email.meaning: the email address on file for statements and pricing confirmations

mailing_address.meaning: postal address the cooperative mails settlement checks and patronage notices to

county.meaning: county of the member's home farm, used for territory and route assignment

tax_id_last4.meaning: last four digits of the taxpayer identification number on the member's W-9; the full number is never stored

membership_since.meaning: date the membership application was accepted by the board

preferred_location.meaning: the facility the member normally hauls to; a default for scheduling only and never a restriction on where grain may be delivered

member_status.meaning: standing of the membership itself: active while the member trades, inactive after three years with no business, estate once the cooperative has been notified of the member's death

contract_id.meaning: primary id of the grain marketing contract record

variant_name.meaning: the grain marketing programme held, written as the official contract name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the contract (basis defined in lifecycle.states)

contract_number.format: GC- followed by six digits, e.g. GC-100482
contract_number.meaning: the contract number the member quotes when hauling or pricing

commodity.meaning: the commodity the contract covers; one commodity per contract

crop_year.meaning: the crop year the contract belongs to; the crop year runs 1 September through 31 August and is named for the calendar year in which it ends

contracted_bushels.meaning: bushels the member committed at signing; never changed except by a recorded amendment

open_bushels.meaning: bushels still owed on the contract; identically the sum of the contract_bushels account deltas, so it falls as loads are applied

unpriced_bushels.meaning: delivered bushels carried in the member's unpriced position; identically the sum of the unpriced_bushels account deltas

futures_month.format: exchange symbol plus month and two-digit year, e.g. CZ26
futures_month.meaning: the futures contract month the price or basis is referenced to; blank on flat cash contracts

basis_per_bushel.format: USD per bushel to 4 decimal places, negative under futures
basis_per_bushel.meaning: the basis agreed against the referenced futures month; blank until the basis is fixed

cash_price_per_bushel.format: USD per bushel to 4 decimal places
cash_price_per_bushel.meaning: the flat cash price agreed at signing; blank on contracts whose price is still open

delivery_location.meaning: the facility the contract calls for delivery to; deliveries elsewhere carry a freight differential

delivery_start_date.meaning: first day of the contracted delivery window

delivery_end_date.meaning: last day of the contracted delivery window; deliveries on this date are still inside the window

opened_date.meaning: date the contract application was taken

activated_date.meaning: date the countersigned contract took effect; empty while the contract is still only applied for

closed_date.meaning: date the contract reached a terminal state; empty while it is still live

amendment_count.meaning: how many recorded amendments this contract has taken since activation

roll_count.meaning: how many times the delivery period or futures month has been rolled in the current crop year

marketing_agreement_on_file.meaning: whether the signed master grain marketing agreement covering this crop year is on file for this member

credit_approval_on_file.meaning: whether the grain desk credit review required for deferred-delivery programmes has been completed and recorded for this member

ledger_id.meaning: primary id of the grain ledger row

contract_id.meaning: the grain marketing contract this row belongs to (foreign key -> grain_contracts)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the grain charter

ticket_number.format: T- followed by seven digits, e.g. T-3049117
ticket_number.meaning: the scale ticket number the elevator issued for one truckload; unique per load and the narrowest key back to a delivery

delivery_date.meaning: the date the load crossed the scale

posted_date.meaning: the date the row was posted to the member's grain ledger

disposition.meaning: what the member told the scale house to do with the load: apply it to a contract, put it into store, or ship it straight through

condition_flag.meaning: the moisture condition band the probe assigned to the load, which decides whether conditioning is required

pricing_status.meaning: whether the bushels on this row already carry a price or sit in the member's unpriced position

gross_bushels.meaning: bushels weighed across the scale before shrink and grade adjustment

net_bushels.meaning: bushels remaining after moisture shrink is taken; this is the quantity applied to the contract

moisture_pct.meaning: moisture the probe read on this load

test_weight_lbs.format: pounds per bushel to 1 decimal place
test_weight_lbs.meaning: test weight measured on this load

foreign_material_pct.meaning: foreign material measured on this load

damage_pct.meaning: total damaged kernels measured on this load

delivery_location.meaning: the facility that received the load or that the row was written at

hauler.meaning: name of the trucking firm or the member's own outfit that delivered the load, as written on the ticket

position_date.meaning: the date bushels entered the member's unpriced position; the clock for delayed-price service charges runs from this date

pricing_reference.format: PR- followed by six digits, e.g. PR-220841
pricing_reference.meaning: the pricing confirmation number issued when bushels are priced; the narrowest key back to one pricing execution

pricing_channel.meaning: how the member placed the pricing order that this execution came from

priced_bushels.meaning: bushels converted from unpriced to priced by this execution

futures_price.format: USD per bushel to 4 decimal places
futures_price.meaning: the futures level captured on this execution

basis_per_bushel.format: USD per bushel to 4 decimal places, negative under futures
basis_per_bushel.meaning: the basis applied on this row

price_per_bushel.format: USD per bushel to 4 decimal places
price_per_bushel.meaning: the flat price the bushels on this row settle at

roll_reference.format: RL- followed by six digits, e.g. RL-004417
roll_reference.meaning: the roll confirmation number; the narrowest key back to one roll of the delivery period or futures month

prior_futures_month.format: exchange symbol plus month and two-digit year, e.g. CZ26
prior_futures_month.meaning: the futures month the position sat in before this roll

futures_month.format: exchange symbol plus month and two-digit year, e.g. CH27
futures_month.meaning: the futures month the position sits in after this roll, or that this execution referenced

roll_spread_per_bushel.format: USD per bushel to 4 decimal places, signed
roll_spread_per_bushel.meaning: the market spread between the prior and new futures month, carried to the member; negative when the roll costs the member

roll_fee_per_bushel.format: USD per bushel to 4 decimal places
roll_fee_per_bushel.meaning: the cooperative's administrative charge for performing the roll

roll_date.meaning: the date the roll was executed

settlement_number.format: S- followed by six digits, e.g. S-551903
settlement_number.meaning: the settlement statement number; the narrowest key tying deductions and payments back to one statement

gross_amount.meaning: value of the settled bushels before any deduction

net_amount.meaning: amount payable to the member after every deduction on the statement

settlement_date.meaning: the date the settlement statement was issued

payment_method.meaning: how the member elected to be paid for this settlement

payment_reference.format: CK- or AC- followed by six digits, e.g. CK-778210
payment_reference.meaning: the check or remittance number of the payment issued

paid_date.meaning: the date funds were released to the member

deduction_type.meaning: which class of deduction this line carries

amount.meaning: money moving on this row; charges and deductions are positive and reversals negative

pricing_order_id.meaning: primary id of the pricing instruction record

contract_id.meaning: the grain marketing contract the instruction applies to (foreign key -> grain_contracts)

order_type.meaning: what the member instructed the grain desk to do

order_status.meaning: how far the instruction has progressed; only an executed instruction has moved bushels

requested_bushels.meaning: bushels the member asked to act on

requested_price.format: USD per bushel to 4 decimal places
requested_price.meaning: the level the member asked for on a target offer; blank on instructions priced at the market

signed_by_member.meaning: whether the member has signed the instruction; unsigned instructions are held and never executed

received_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
received_at.meaning: moment the grain desk registered the instruction

effective_date.meaning: the trading day the instruction is worked on

agreement_id.meaning: primary id of the grain storage agreement record

variant_name.meaning: the storage programme held, written as the official agreement name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the storage agreement (basis defined in lifecycle.states)

agreement_number.format: SA- followed by six digits, e.g. SA-208114
agreement_number.meaning: the storage agreement number printed on storage statements

commodity.meaning: the commodity held in store under this agreement

crop_year.meaning: the crop year the stored grain came from; the crop year runs 1 September through 31 August

storage_location.meaning: the facility physically holding the grain

bushels_in_store.meaning: bushels currently held under this agreement; identically the sum of the stored_bushels account deltas

reserved_bushels.meaning: bushels inside bushels_in_store already pledged against a warehouse receipt or a contract and therefore not free to load out

storage_start_date.meaning: the date the first bushels went into store under this agreement; the free-day clock runs from this date

storage_end_date.meaning: the date the agreement is scheduled to end; empty on agreements with no fixed end

paid_through_date.meaning: the last date storage has been billed and paid through

opened_date.meaning: date the storage agreement application was taken

closed_date.meaning: date the agreement reached a terminal state; empty while it is still live

warehouse_receipt_number.format: WR- followed by six digits, e.g. WR-003318
warehouse_receipt_number.meaning: the negotiable warehouse receipt number issued against the stored grain; empty where no receipt has been issued

quality_grade.meaning: the grade the grain was received on and is obliged to be returned at

insurance_on_file.meaning: whether the member's own stored-grain insurance certificate is on file, which some programmes require before receipts are issued

aeration_enrolled.meaning: whether this agreement is enrolled in the scheduled aeration and turning service

charge_id.meaning: primary id of the storage charge row

agreement_id.meaning: the storage agreement this row belongs to (foreign key -> storage_agreements)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the storage charter

charge_date.meaning: the date the charge or movement was recorded

period_start.meaning: first day of the billing period this accrual covers; blank on charges that are not period-based

period_end.meaning: last day of the billing period this accrual covers, counted inclusively; blank on charges that are not period-based

charge_type.meaning: which class of storage activity this row records

billing_basis.meaning: the basis the rate on this row is quoted on, which fixes how amount is arrived at

rate.format: USD to 5 decimal places, quoted on the basis named in billing_basis
rate.meaning: the rate applied on this row

amount.meaning: money moving on this row; charges are positive and reversals or credits negative

points_removed.meaning: moisture points taken out by the dryer on this pass

shrink_bushels.meaning: bushels lost to shrink and handling on this row

loadout_reference.format: LO- followed by six digits, e.g. LO-114290
loadout_reference.meaning: the load-out order number; the narrowest key back to one load-out instruction

ticket_number.format: T- followed by seven digits, e.g. T-3049117
ticket_number.meaning: the scale ticket number of the load this row came from; the narrowest key back to one truckload

truck_count.meaning: how many trucks the load-out took

invoice_number.format: SI- followed by six digits, e.g. SI-660014
invoice_number.meaning: the storage invoice number this charge was billed on; empty until billed

paid_flag.meaning: whether this charge has been paid or settled out of grain proceeds

posted_date.meaning: the date the row was posted to the member's storage account

request_id.meaning: primary id of the storage service request record

agreement_id.meaning: the storage agreement the request applies to (foreign key -> storage_agreements)

request_type.meaning: what the member asked the elevator to do with the stored grain

request_status.meaning: how far the request has progressed; only a completed request has moved grain

requested_bushels.meaning: bushels the member asked to act on

requested_date.meaning: the date the member asked the work to happen on

signed_by_member.meaning: whether the member has signed the request; unsigned requests are held and never worked

received_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
received_at.meaning: moment the elevator registered the request

account_id.meaning: primary id of the crop input account record

variant_name.meaning: the crop input purchasing programme held, written as the official account name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the input account (basis defined in lifecycle.states)

account_number.format: IA- followed by six digits, e.g. IA-330192
account_number.meaning: the input account number printed on every input invoice and statement

credit_limit.meaning: the approved ceiling on the unpaid input balance this account may carry

current_balance.meaning: amount currently owed on the account; identically the sum of the input_receivable account deltas

prepay_balance.meaning: unspent prepay money held to the member's credit; identically the sum of the prepay_credit account deltas

terms_days.meaning: the payment terms recorded on this account, counted from the invoice date

billing_cycle_day.meaning: the day of the month the account statement closes

opened_date.meaning: date the input account application was taken

closed_date.meaning: date the account reached a terminal state; empty while it is still live

credit_review_date.meaning: date of the most recent completed credit review on this account

credit_status.meaning: the credit department's standing decision on this account, which is authoritative over any statement the member makes about their credit

lien_on_file.meaning: whether a perfected security interest covering the growing crop is on file, which the financing programmes require

acres_enrolled.meaning: acres the member has enrolled under this account for the current crop year

past_due_since.meaning: the date the oldest unpaid invoice on this account went past its due date; empty when nothing is past due

invoice_id.meaning: primary id of the crop input invoice row

account_id.meaning: the crop input account this row belongs to (foreign key -> agronomy_accounts)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the agronomy charter

invoice_number.format: IN- followed by seven digits, e.g. IN-4410287
invoice_number.meaning: the invoice number the member quotes when paying or disputing; the narrowest key back to one billed order

invoice_date.meaning: the date the invoice was raised; payment terms are counted from this date

due_date.meaning: the last day payment is on time; payment on this date is still on time

product_category.meaning: the input class billed on this row, which decides which discount schedule applies

product_name.meaning: the product as printed on the delivery ticket, including brand and formulation

quantity.format: number to 2 decimal places, in the unit named in unit_of_measure
quantity.meaning: how much product this row bills

unit_of_measure.meaning: the unit quantity and unit_price are quoted in

unit_price.format: USD to 2 decimal places per unit_of_measure
unit_price.meaning: the price per unit billed on this row before discount

extended_amount.meaning: quantity times unit price, before any discount

discount_type.meaning: which discount, if any, was granted on this row

discount_amount.meaning: money taken off the extended amount by the discount on this row

amount.meaning: money moving on this row; charges are positive and payments, credits and reversals negative

finance_charge_amount.meaning: service charge assessed on an overdue balance on this row

payment_reference.format: PY- followed by six digits, e.g. PY-901772
payment_reference.meaning: the remittance reference of the payment this row records; the narrowest key back to one payment

payment_method.meaning: how the member paid on this row

posted_date.meaning: the date the row was posted to the member's input account

delivery_ticket_number.format: DT- followed by seven digits, e.g. DT-2210554
delivery_ticket_number.meaning: the delivery ticket the product left the plant on

field_name.meaning: the field the product was delivered for, as the member names it

balance_after.meaning: the account balance immediately after this row posted

booking_reference.format: BK- followed by six digits, e.g. BK-770315
booking_reference.meaning: the prepay booking number; the narrowest key back to one prepay commitment and the product it reserved

order_id.meaning: primary id of the crop input service request record

account_id.meaning: the crop input account the request applies to (foreign key -> agronomy_accounts)

order_type.meaning: what the member asked the agronomy desk to do

order_status.meaning: how far the request has progressed; only an approved or fulfilled request has committed the cooperative

requested_amount.meaning: the money or limit the member asked for

requested_date.meaning: the date the member asked the work to happen on

signed_by_member.meaning: whether the member has signed the request; unsigned requests are held and never worked

received_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
received_at.meaning: moment the agronomy desk registered the request

membership_id.meaning: primary id of the patronage membership record

variant_name.meaning: the membership and equity class held, written as the official class name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the membership (basis defined in lifecycle.states)

membership_number.format: MB- followed by six digits, e.g. MB-018844
membership_number.meaning: the equity account number printed on patronage notices

equity_balance.meaning: total equity the cooperative holds for this member; identically the sum of the member_equity account deltas

allocated_equity_balance.meaning: the part of equity_balance that has been allocated by the board but not yet revolved out

common_stock_shares.meaning: shares of common stock the membership carries; voting classes carry one share

voting_rights.meaning: whether this class votes at the annual meeting

joined_date.meaning: date the equity account was opened

closed_date.meaning: date the equity account reached a terminal state; empty while it is still live

last_allocation_year.meaning: the most recent fiscal year in which patronage was allocated to this membership

revolvement_eligible_year.meaning: the fiscal year the oldest unrevolved allocation on this membership becomes eligible under the board's revolvement cycle

birth_year.meaning: the member's year of birth as recorded on the membership application; the basis for age retirement

estate_flag.meaning: whether the cooperative has recorded notice of the member's death together with the supporting document

tax_reporting_status.meaning: how the allocations on this membership are reported for tax, which decides the cash portion obligation

entry_id.meaning: primary id of the patronage ledger row

membership_id.meaning: the patronage membership this row belongs to (foreign key -> patronage_memberships)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the patronage charter

entry_date.meaning: the date the row was recorded

fiscal_year.meaning: the cooperative fiscal year the row belongs to; the fiscal year ends 31 August

allocation_basis.meaning: which stream of business the units on this row were earned on; each stream is allocated at its own rate

patronage_units.format: number to 2 decimal places, in the unit implied by allocation_basis
patronage_units.meaning: the volume of qualifying business the row records

rate_per_unit.format: USD to 4 decimal places per unit
rate_per_unit.meaning: the board-declared allocation rate applied to the units on this row

allocated_amount.meaning: total patronage allocated on this row before the cash and equity split

cash_portion_amount.meaning: the part of the allocation paid out in cash

equity_portion_amount.meaning: the part of the allocation retained as member equity

retain_amount.meaning: per-unit capital retained on this row over and above the patronage allocation

revolvement_amount.meaning: equity paid back out to the member on this row under the board's revolvement cycle

payment_reference.format: PD- followed by six digits, e.g. PD-330417
payment_reference.meaning: the patronage payment reference; the narrowest key back to one disbursement

payment_method.meaning: how the cash portion or revolvement was delivered to the member

notice_number.format: PN- followed by six digits, e.g. PN-201188
notice_number.meaning: the written patronage notice number the allocation was reported on; the narrowest key back to one allocation notice

tax_form_type.meaning: which information return the row is reported on

posted_date.meaning: the date the row was posted to the member's equity account

adjustment_reason.meaning: why an allocation was adjusted; none on rows that are not adjustments

transfer_counterparty_id.meaning: the member the equity moved to or from on a transfer row (foreign key -> customers); empty on rows that are not transfers

request_id.meaning: primary id of the equity service request record

membership_id.meaning: the membership the request applies to (foreign key -> patronage_memberships)

request_type.meaning: what the member or their representative asked the equity desk to do

request_status.meaning: how far the request has progressed; only an approved or completed request has bound the board

requested_amount.meaning: the equity the member asked to move or retire

requested_date.meaning: the date the request was made

signed_by_member.meaning: whether the member or their legal representative has signed the request; unsigned requests are held and never worked

received_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
received_at.meaning: moment the equity desk registered the request

energy_account_id.meaning: primary id of the refined fuels and propane account record

variant_name.meaning: the energy delivery programme held, written as the official account name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the energy account (basis defined in lifecycle.states)

account_number.format: EA- followed by six digits, e.g. EA-512044
account_number.meaning: the energy account number printed on delivery tickets and statements

product.meaning: the fuel this account is set up to receive

tank_size_gallons.meaning: water capacity of the tank serving this account

tank_ownership.meaning: who owns the tank, which decides whether tank rent applies and who may service it

contract_gallons.meaning: gallons booked ahead at a fixed price on this account; zero where nothing is contracted

contract_price_per_gallon.format: USD per gallon to 4 decimal places
contract_price_per_gallon.meaning: the fixed price the contracted gallons draw at; zero where nothing is contracted

budget_monthly_amount.meaning: the level monthly instalment agreed under a budget plan; zero where the account is not on a budget plan

delivery_route.meaning: the delivery route the tank sits on, which decides scheduled delivery days and whether a stop is out of route

last_delivery_date.meaning: the date of the most recent delivery to this tank

opened_date.meaning: date the energy account application was taken

closed_date.meaning: date the account reached a terminal state; empty while it is still live

tank_rent_due_date.meaning: the next date annual tank rent falls due on this account; empty on member-owned tanks

keep_full_enrolled.meaning: whether the tank is on the automatic keep-full schedule rather than waiting for the member to call

current_gallons_owed.meaning: gallons still owed to the member out of the contracted pre-buy; identically the sum of the contract_gallons account deltas

account_balance.meaning: amount currently owed on the energy account; identically the sum of the fuel_receivable account deltas

delivery_id.meaning: primary id of the energy delivery or charge row

energy_account_id.meaning: the energy account this row belongs to (foreign key -> energy_accounts)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the energy charter

delivery_date.meaning: the date the truck delivered or the charge was raised

ticket_number.format: ET- followed by seven digits, e.g. ET-6610338
ticket_number.meaning: the delivery ticket number the driver left with the member; the narrowest key back to one stop

product.meaning: the fuel delivered or billed on this row

delivery_type.meaning: how the stop was ordered, which decides which delivery fees apply

gallons.meaning: gallons pumped on this stop or drawn on this row

price_per_gallon.format: USD per gallon to 4 decimal places
price_per_gallon.meaning: the price the gallons on this row were billed at

amount.meaning: money moving on this row; charges are positive and payments, credits and reversals negative

fee_type.meaning: which class of fee this row carries; none on rows that are not fees

fee_amount.meaning: the fee charged on this row

driver_name.meaning: name of the driver who made the stop, as signed on the ticket

invoice_number.format: EI- followed by six digits, e.g. EI-440820
invoice_number.meaning: the energy invoice number this row was billed on; empty until billed

payment_reference.format: EP- followed by six digits, e.g. EP-118093
payment_reference.meaning: the remittance reference of the payment this row records; the narrowest key back to one payment

payment_method.meaning: how the member paid on this row

posted_date.meaning: the date the row was posted to the member's energy account

tank_percent_before.meaning: tank gauge reading the driver took before pumping

tank_percent_after.meaning: tank gauge reading the driver took after pumping

billing_month.meaning: the budget plan month this instalment covers; empty on rows that are not budget instalments

contract_reference.format: EC- followed by six digits, e.g. EC-330118
contract_reference.meaning: the contract gallon booking reference; the narrowest key back to one pre-buy commitment and the gallons it reserved

energy_order_id.meaning: primary id of the energy service request record

energy_account_id.meaning: the energy account the request applies to (foreign key -> energy_accounts)

order_type.meaning: what the member asked the energy desk to do

order_status.meaning: how far the request has progressed; only a completed request has been carried out

requested_date.meaning: the date the member asked the work to happen on

signed_by_member.meaning: whether the member has signed the request; unsigned requests are held and never worked

received_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
received_at.meaning: moment the energy desk registered the request

plan_id.meaning: primary id of the custom application service plan record

variant_name.meaning: the custom application programme held, written as the official plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the service plan (basis defined in lifecycle.states)

plan_number.format: CP- followed by six digits, e.g. CP-702118
plan_number.meaning: the plan number quoted on every work order

crop_year.meaning: the crop year the plan covers

enrolled_acres.meaning: acres committed to the plan for the crop year

service_window_start.meaning: first day the plan's committed rates apply

service_window_end.meaning: last day the plan's committed rates apply, counted inclusively

primary_field.meaning: the field name the member uses for the home quarter covered by the plan

opened_date.meaning: date the plan application was taken

closed_date.meaning: date the plan reached a terminal state; empty while it is still live

prescription_on_file.meaning: whether a current variable-rate prescription is on file, which the prescription programmes require before work is released

applicator_license_verified.meaning: whether the licence covering restricted-use product application has been verified for this plan's crop year

acres_applied.meaning: acres worked so far under the plan; identically the sum of the applied_acres account deltas

workorder_id.meaning: primary id of the custom application work order row

plan_id.meaning: the service plan this row belongs to (foreign key -> custom_service_plans)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the custom charter

work_date.meaning: the date the work was done or scheduled for

workorder_number.format: WO- followed by seven digits, e.g. WO-5520147
workorder_number.meaning: the work order number; the narrowest key back to one pass across one field

service_type.meaning: the operation performed, which decides the per-acre rate band

rate_per_acre.format: USD per acre to 2 decimal places
rate_per_acre.meaning: the rate billed per acre on this row

amount.meaning: money moving on this row; charges are positive and credits negative

product_used.meaning: the product applied, as written on the work order

field_name.meaning: the field worked, as the member names it

weather_hold_flag.meaning: whether the pass was stopped or postponed by field conditions

reschedule_reason.meaning: why a pass was rescheduled; none on rows that are not reschedules

invoice_number.format: CI- followed by six digits, e.g. CI-880431
invoice_number.meaning: the custom application invoice number this row was billed on; empty until billed

posted_date.meaning: the date the row was posted to the member's service account

applicator_name.meaning: name of the applicator who ran the pass, as signed on the work order

surcharge_type.meaning: which class of surcharge this row carries; none on rows that are not surcharges

program_id.meaning: primary id of the feed and nutrition programme record

variant_name.meaning: the feed programme held, written as the official programme name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the feed programme (basis defined in lifecycle.states)

program_number.format: FP- followed by six digits, e.g. FP-140228
program_number.meaning: the feed programme number quoted on delivery tickets

species.meaning: the species the ration is formulated for

head_count.meaning: head on feed under this programme, which sizes the delivery schedule

ration_code.format: three letters followed by three digits, e.g. BCF210
ration_code.meaning: the mill's formula code for the ration being fed

delivery_frequency.meaning: how often the mill is scheduled to deliver

bin_capacity_tons.meaning: capacity of the feed bin serving this programme

opened_date.meaning: date the programme application was taken

closed_date.meaning: date the programme reached a terminal state; empty while it is still live

nutritionist_assigned.meaning: name of the nutritionist assigned to the programme; blank where none is assigned

vfd_on_file.meaning: whether a current veterinary feed directive is on file, which medicated rations require before the mill may run them

tons_delivered.meaning: tons delivered so far under the programme; identically the sum of the feed_tons account deltas

feed_invoice_id.meaning: primary id of the feed invoice row

program_id.meaning: the feed programme this row belongs to (foreign key -> feed_programs)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the feed charter

invoice_date.meaning: the date the row was raised

invoice_number.format: FI- followed by six digits, e.g. FI-330919
invoice_number.meaning: the feed invoice number; the narrowest key back to one billed delivery

feed_type.meaning: the class of feed billed on this row

price_per_ton.format: USD per ton to 2 decimal places
price_per_ton.meaning: the price per ton billed on this row

amount.meaning: money moving on this row; charges are positive and payments and credits negative

delivery_ticket_number.format: FT- followed by seven digits, e.g. FT-7710224
delivery_ticket_number.meaning: the mill delivery ticket number; the narrowest key back to one load

medication_flag.meaning: whether the ration on this row carries a medicated additive

vfd_reference.format: VFD- followed by six digits, e.g. VFD-004411
vfd_reference.meaning: the veterinary feed directive the medicated ration was run under; empty on unmedicated rows

ration_code.format: three letters followed by three digits, e.g. BCF210
ration_code.meaning: the formula code run on this row

posted_date.meaning: the date the row was posted to the member's feed account

payment_reference.format: FY- followed by six digits, e.g. FY-660127
payment_reference.meaning: the remittance reference of the payment this row records

payment_method.meaning: how the member paid on this row

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record

verified.meaning: whether verification passed; monotonically non-decreasing once true

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt recorded

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

service_request_id.meaning: primary id of the custom application service request record

plan_id.meaning: the service plan the request applies to (foreign key -> custom_service_plans)

request_type.meaning: what the member asked the application desk to do

request_status.meaning: how far the request has progressed; only a completed request has put equipment in the field

requested_acres.meaning: acres the member asked to have worked

requested_date.meaning: the date the member asked the work to happen on

field_name.meaning: the field the request concerns, as the member names it

signed_by_member.meaning: whether the member has signed the request; unsigned requests are held and never released

received_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
received_at.meaning: moment the application desk registered the request

feed_request_id.meaning: primary id of the feed programme service request record

program_id.meaning: the feed programme the request applies to (foreign key -> feed_programs)

request_type.meaning: what the member asked the mill to do

request_status.meaning: how far the request has progressed; only a completed request has been run by the mill

requested_date.meaning: the date the member asked the work to happen on

ration_code.format: three letters followed by three digits, e.g. BCF210
ration_code.meaning: the formula code the request concerns

signed_by_member.meaning: whether the member has signed the request; unsigned requests are held and never run

received_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
received_at.meaning: moment the mill registered the request
